# Nico's Trattoria

> > Italian culinary school in Amsterdam offering hands-on cooking workshops in pasta-making, Neapolitan pizza, and authentic Southern Italian cuisine led by Chef Nico.

Nico's Trattoria is Chef Nico's culinary school located at Contactweg 47 in Amsterdam, specializing in traditional Italian cooking techniques from regions like Napoli, Toscane, and Piemonte. The school offers workshops ranging from beginner pasta classes to 4-day masterclasses, pizza workshops using Ooni ovens, catering services, and gift vouchers for culinary experiences.

## Key Topics

- Italian cuisine & cooking classes
- Fresh pasta making (tagliatelle, ravioli, tortelloni, pici, gnocchi)
- Neapolitan pizza workshops
- Chef Nico & family recipes
- Amsterdam culinary school (Contactweg 47)
- Ooni pizza ovens
- Southern Italian regional cooking (Napoli, Toscane, Piemonte)
- Hands-on cooking workshops
- Team building & group activities
- Gift vouchers & culinary experiences
- Catering services
- Masterclass programs
- Slow food philosophy
- Italian culinary traditions

## About Nico's Trattoria

- [Meet Chef Nico](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/about): Chef Nico's story from Napoli to Amsterdam, family recipes & slow food
- [Doe mee aan een kookworkshop in Amsterdam](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/nl/kookworkshops): Overview of Italian cooking workshops: pasta, pizza & team building

## Pasta Workshops

- [Masterclass Verse Pasta](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/nl/kookworkshops/masterclass-verse-pasta): 4-day fresh pasta masterclass covering tagliatelle, tortelloni techniques
- [Pastaworkshop](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/nl/kookworkshops/pastaworkshop): Fresh pasta workshop with Chef Nico: ravioli, tagliatelle & tiramisu
- [Zuidelijke Smaken Pasta Workshop](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/nl/kookworkshops/zuidelijke-smaken-pasta-workshop): Southern Italian pasta workshop featuring scialatielli & orecchiette

## Pizza Workshops

- [Pizzaworkshop](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/nl/kookworkshops/pizzaworkshop): Authentic Italian pizza-making workshop with Ooni ovens in Amsterdam
- [Pizza Workshop](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/workshops/pizza-workshop): Hands-on Neapolitan pizza workshop with dough kneading in Amsterdam

## Gift Vouchers & Catering

- [Kookworkshop Cadeaubon](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/nl/kookworkshops/cadeaubon): Gift vouchers for Italian cooking workshop experiences at Nico's Trattoria
- [Culinary Experience Gift Voucher](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/workshops/gift-voucher): Gift vouchers for Italian cooking workshop experiences at Nico's Trattoria
- [Catering Services for your Special Occasion](https://www.nicostrattoria.nl/catering): Italian catering with lasagna, parmigiana for corporate & special events
